name: Onee-chan ni Ubawarete
original_name: お姉ちゃんに奪われて
source:
After graduating from university, a big breasted girl returns home after a 4 year absence. There she begins a new life living together with her brother. But she steals her brother's virginity and ravishes him every day. This is an incest love comedy.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ043998.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
大学毕业后，阔胸妹子回到了阔别四年的家乡。在那里，她开始了与哥哥一起生活的新生活。但她偷走了她哥哥的童贞，每天都对他进行蹂躏。这是一部乱伦爱情喜剧。
